skills.name: Debut (初舞)
skills.description:
Shiranui dances to the music and send off butterflies to launch 2-strike attack on a single target, dealing damage equal to 50% of her ATK with each strike.
When Shiranui is in Sorrowful state, the skill changes to Finale.

skills.name: Finale (終舞)
skills.description: Shiranui stokes the flames and send over fire butterflies to launch a 2-strike attack, dealing damage equal to 62% of her ATK with each strike.

skills.name: Silhouette of Sorrow (離影)
skills.line: The border between humans and spirits gradually began to blur.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
If an ally uses a normal attack or is immobile on their turn, Shiranui has a 50% chance of performing a dance at the end of that turn, spending 5% of her current HP to increase the RES of the ally by 50%, lasts for 1 turn.
When Shiranui is in Sorrowful state, the skill changes to Song of Sorrow. ; : ;Upon Usage :This skill can only be used when Shiranui's HP is below 50%. Enters Sorrowful state and uses Blazing Flames without any onibi. ;Sorrowful State (離別) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Increases Crit by 30%. At the end of an ally's or enemy's turn, she restores her HP by 40% of her lost HP. At the end of her own turn, 15% of her max HP is lost.
Her attacks inflict Blaze of Sorrow. When attacking targets inflicted with Blaze of Sorrow, the effect is consumed to deal double damage.
When entering this state, her HP is restored to 100% and all buffs and debuffs are removed from her.

upgrades.text: While the Sparkling Flame realm is active, chance of her performing a dance is increases to 100%.

skills.name: Song of Sorrow (離歌)
skills.description: Shiranui increases her own SPD by 20.

upgrades.text: Each onibi you have increases her SPD by 5.
Each onibi you have also increases her RES by 5%.
After using Blazing Flames, for each onibi you have dealing damage equal to 46% of her ATK.

skills.name: Blazing Sky (星火満天)
skills.line: Look at the flames as they light up the sky. May this moment last forever.
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
Shiranui forms a Sparkling Flame realm, last for 2 turns. While the realm is active, all allies' damage dealt is increased by 10%, SPD by 25 and damage reduction by 10%.
When the realm is active and an ally use their normal attack on their turn, they have a 50% chance of using an extra normal attack on the same target again. The extra normal attack will not trigger the attacker's passive and the target's passive or souls.
When Shiranui is in Sorrowful state, the skill changes to Blazing Flame.

upgrades.text: Extra normal attacks ignore 200 DEF and inflict 30% of HP steal.
While Sparkling Flame realm is active, every onibi increases damage dealt by 2% and damage reduction by 2%.
Chance of using an extra normal attack increases to 100%.
'''Upper Hand''': Blazing Sky is automatically used at the start of battle.

skills.name: Blazing Flame (燼染不夜/火蝶炎舞)
skills.description: Shiranui performs a dance of flame and attacks all enemies, dealing damage equal to 125% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: For each ally KO'd, onibi cost decreases by 1.
